data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2468 reported a significant gross prior year reserve release of GBP 48.439 million in 2021, representing a 10.34% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release is reflected in the 'Change in estimates of technical provisions' and indicates favorable claims development across prior underwriting years. The syndicate is in run-off, and its 2019 and prior years of account were reinsured to close into Syndicate 3500 as of 1st January 2022. The report explicitly states that COVID-19 did not materially impact its 2021 financial results.
